summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the government's ordinary annual services.
It would provide about seven-twelfths of the estimated annual appropriations for 2022-2023, plus new budget measures, covering the final seven months of the financial year.
The remaining five-twelfths, minus budget measures, would be covered by a separate supply bill.
changes: The bill appropriates money from the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
It sets the amount at seven-twelfths of the estimated annual appropriations for 2022-2023, plus budget measures.
The bill only covers ordinary annual services, with other appropriations in a separate bill.
summary.affected: The government's ordinary annual services are affected.
